# uptimekuma_info (Data Source)

Metadata about the Uptime Kuma server, as reported after login.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimekuma_info" "server" {}

# A containerised instance cannot run the sip-options, tailscale-ping or
# system-service monitor types.
output "server_version" {
  value = data.uptimekuma_info.server.version
}

output "is_container" {
  value = data.uptimekuma_info.server.is_container
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `database_type` (String) Database backend, for example `sqlite` or `mariadb`.
- `is_container` (Boolean) Whether the server runs in a container. Containerised instances cannot use the sip-options, tailscale-ping or system-service monitor types.
- `latest_version` (String) Latest version the server knows about.
- `primary_base_url` (String) Configured primary base URL, if any.
- `server_timezone` (String) Server timezone.
- `version` (String) Running Uptime Kuma version.
